title: RNA extraction using the PureLink® RNA Mini Kit
author: Enrico Bagnoli

steps.title: Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Remove growth medium from cells (e.g., from a 15 cm 2 dish). Collect cells in 1 ml of DPBS and allocate 1/3 of the sample for RNA extraction.

steps.title: Lysis
steps.instruction: Using RNase-free pipette tips, add the appropriate volume of lysis buffer prepared with 2-mercaptoethanol to the sample.

steps.title: Homogenization
steps.instruction: Perform one of the following homogenization options at Room temperature:

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Transfer lysate to a homogenizer inserted in a collection tube and centrifuge at 12000 x g for 2 minutes; remove homogenizer when done.

Option 2: Transfer lysate to an appropriately sized RNase-free tube and homogenize using a rotorstator homogenizer at maximum speed for at least 00:00:45. Centrifuge homogenate at ~2600 x g for 5 minutes, then transfer supernatant to a clean RNase-free tube.

Option 3: Transfer lysate to a 1.5 mL RNase-free tube and pass 5-10 times through an 18-21 gauge needle attached to an RNase-free syringe (e.g., 10 passages in a 20G needle in 300 µL of lysis buffer). Centrifuge homogenate at ~2600 x g for 5 minutes, then transfer supernatant to a clean RNase-free tube.

steps.title: Prepare Sample for Binding
steps.instruction: Add one volume of 70% ethanol to each volume of cell homogenate (adjust ethanol volume if sample was lost during homogenization).

substeps.instruction: Vortex to mix thoroughly and disperse any visible precipitate.

steps.title: Bind RNA to Spin Cartridge
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample (including any remaining precipitate) to the Spin Cartridge with the Collection Tube.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 15 seconds at Room temperature.
Discard the flow-through and reinsert the Spin Cartridge into the same collection tube.
If processing the maximum starting amount of sample, centrifuge for up to 00:10:00 to completely pass the lysate through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation process until the entire sample is processed.

Add 700 µL Wash Buffer I to the Spin Cartridge. Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 15 seconds at Room temperature. Discard flow-through and Collection Tube, then place Spin Cartridge into a new Collection Tube.

Add 500 µL Wash Buffer II with ethanol to the Spin Cartridge. Centrifuge at 12000 x g for 15 seconds at Room temperature. Discard flow-through and reinsert the Spin Cartridge into the same collection tube.
Repeat the Wash Buffer II step once more.

steps.title: Dry Membrane
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the Spin Cartridge at 12000 x g for 00:01:00 - 00:02:00 to dry the membrane. Discard the collection tube and insert the Spin Cartridge into a recovery tube.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL to 3 x 100 µL RNase-Free Water (e.g., 50 µL) to the center of the Spin Cartridge.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge for 00:02:00 at ≥ 12000 x g at Room temperature to elute RNA into the recovery tube.
If performing sequential elutions, collect all elutes into the same tube.

steps.title: Storage
steps.instruction: Store the purified RNA or proceed to analysis or DNase I treatment.
